hypotheses.title: Subindustry Relative Implied-to-Parkinson Volatility Risk Premium
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits the cross-sectional Volatility Risk Premium (VRP) by comparing long-dated call implied volatility (implied_volatility_call_720) against realized Parkinson high-low volatility (parkinson_volatility_120) with a 120-day backfill. Evaluating this ratio strictly within GICS Subindustry peers strips out sector-specific volatility clustering, isolating idiosyncratic options demand and institutional upside positioning.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms when option skew collapses or market realized volatility exceeds implied volatility during systemic crashes.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized Volatility Risk Premium (720d Call IV / 120d Parkinson Realized Volatility with 120d backfill)
